caption: Spicy reddish-brown glossy broth with noodles and toppings sits in a white ceramic bowl with red stripes and black characters. The bowl has a slightly chipped rim on a dark textured surface with a gold edge on the left, holding a white ceramic spoon.

segments_info.text: Dark textured surface with subtle grain, slightly reflective, bordered by gold edge on left.
The spicy broth is reddish-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles and toppings.
White ceramic bowl with red stripes and black characters, smooth surface, slightly chipped rim.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved bowl shape.
